title: Study on the discoloration phenomenon caused by iron ion oxidation in Boston ivy pads and its effect on adhesion force
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38806-38814
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04605F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rui Zhang, Yida Zhang, Zili Li, Xiaobin Xu, Quan Xu
We discovered a phenomenon of oxidation and discoloration in Boston ivy pads. The transition from Fe2+ to Fe3+ in the pad caused the oxidation discoloration reaction and reduced the adhesion of the pad.
